96: MISHNA: Property that serves as a guarantee - namely, land, because the surety of everyone -- the borrower and the one who lends to his friend -- is upon it, since it lasts and persists. Therefore, people rely on it.
By taking possession - if he hoed it a little (Bava Batra 54b:3), or walked upon its boundaries (Bava Kamma 9a:3), or fenced it or breached [its fence] even a bit (Bava Batra 42a:9).

Can be acquired along with property etc. - if one sold movable objects along with land. The moment that the buyer acquires the land using one of the three methods of acquisition, the movable objects are acquired along with it.
